style: 3D animated dry satire; penguin two thirds of frame

subject.character: ONE emperor penguin, tailcoat under a fur coat, bow tie; fully serious

second_characters: ONE tusked walrus, bag, jar bandolier, burner on strap; fish school, one angry toothy fish

props.kit: cupping jars; blue-flame burner; four wicks on his back under the coat
props.money: banknote bundles; fat wallet under coat
props.shrimp: pink shrimp in outer coat pocket

environment: ice floe edge, ridges, blue water, day
lighting: sun behind: gold rim left, blue rim right
motion_rule: camera orbits them low, never still, new shot size every beat; something moves every beat

audio.delivery: flat low male voice, brisk, native, no accent
audio.pacing: each line once in its beat, no pause after Я; silence 1.97-2.55 and 4.85-5.80; after 6.65 rip, ice hiss, rotor roar, clinks, pops, no words
audio.stress: плачу: stress on the last syllable, chOO
audio.lip_sync: beak opens on every syllable, beak empty

timeline.a: tracking low: he skids along the edge, flings a fistful of shrimp from his pocket into the water without looking
low at the water, arc: water boils, fish devour the shrimp; one angry fish leaps at the lens, snaps its teeth once, fish silent; he skids on mid-frame, beak speaking
tracking beside: he yanks the wallet out, flicks a bundle over his shoulder; walrus bounds in, catches it
head-on, low: he belly-slides head-first off a ridge into the lens, face fills frame, beak shut; walrus toboggans after
tracking beside: he stumbles on flat ice, never stopping, flings two bundles back; walrus catches one mid-leap, tusks the other into the bag
tracking beside: he skids round a ridge in a curve across frame, tosses one more back, beak speaking; walrus belly-slides after, catches it in teeth, spits it in
head-on, low: he belly-slides over a water crack, slips out sideways, splash; walrus vaults it, slides into the lens, tusks, whiskers, bundle in jaws fill frame
tracking beside: he skids sideways, flips the empty wallet over his shoulder; walrus holds the bag open mid-bound, wallet drops in, beak speaking
swift arc: rip; walrus yanks the coat off by the collar, rams it in the bag, zips the bag with his teeth; he spins out like a top, four wicks on his back, beak shut
low, tracking, helicopter at top edge, ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ leaflets pour: he skids on under them; walrus, bag under flipper, sweeps burner flame over his back, wicks catch, whoosh
tracking beside: he scrambles ahead, flippers windmilling; walrus bounds after, slaps bandolier jars on lit wicks mid-leap, four pops
low, swift arc: a jar clinks a tusk, the bag bursts, bundles and coat scatter; he stumbles, flops on the coat
head-on, low: riding the coat like a sled, he curves into the lens, glancing back, face and four jars on his back fill frame, beak shut; walrus belly-flops after, bundle in teeth

must_appear: 1.97 penguin face fills lens; 4.85 walrus tusks fill lens; 6.65 coat zipped in bag; 9.40 coat sled, four jars
negative_prompt: slow speech, a repeated word, extra words, fish speaking, walrus speaking, walrus growling, camera standing still, subtitles, watermark, text other than ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ, digits, two penguins, two walruses, walrus wearing the coat, floating objects, duplicate props, hero only from behind, English speech, foreign accent, penguin standing or lying still, penguin running at camera on foot, objects in beak, walrus touching him before 6.65
